/rje btsun pad+mā ka ra la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba/na mo gu ru pad+ma ka rā ya/bde chen 'khor lo'i chu skyes

tei:div.tei:p: /rje btsun pad+mā ka ra la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba/ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka rā ya/ bde chen 'khor lo'i chu skyes dbus/ /bla ma 'chi med thod phreng rtsal/ /bsnyen las dngos grub mchog thob slad/ /skyabs sems sngon song 'di ltar bsgom/ hrīḥ chos kun gdod nas rig stong gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /snod bcud thams cad pad+ma 'od kyi zhing*/ /rig 'dzin grub pa rgya mtsho'i dga' ba'i tshal/ /me tog char 'bebs 'ja' zer 'khrigs pa'i klong*/ /bde stong chu skyes nyi ma bam ro'i steng*/ /rang nyid gzhi lus dbang chen he ru ka /thugs rje chags pa'i sku mdog dmar po la/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan khro bo'i chas kun rdzogs/ /rang 'od rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyor/ /thabs shes spyi bor rta gdong phag zhal bzhad/ /snang stong dbyer med chen por gsal ba yi/ /bde chen 'khor lor pad dkar nyi zla'i steng*/ /ngo bo khyab bdag drin can bla ma la/ /rnam pa 'chi med pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /sku mdog dkar dmar khro 'dzum gzi brjid 'bar/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas thod bum bsnams/ /sku la gsang phod chos gos zab ber dang*/ /dbu la rab mdzes pad+ma'i mnyen zhu gsol/ /lhan skyes 'du 'bral med pa'i ḍā ki ni/ /man+dā ra ba gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud/ /zhabs gnyis phyed skyil mnyam par rol pa yi/ /spyi bor longs sku 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter/ /de'i spyi bor chos sku snang mtha' yas/ /sku gsum dbyer med bde ba chen por bzhugs/ /phyi rol stong gsal 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /thod phreng sde lnga sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad sogs/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rnam rol bsam mi khyab/ /bar mtshams brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang*/ /sgrub sde brgyad sogs yi dam zhi khro'i lha/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srungs tshogs/

/snang stong chu zla lta bur gsal ba yi/ /spyi mgrin snying gar rdo rje gsum gyi dngos/ /rnam thar gsum ldan yi ge 'bru gsum mtshan/ /snyoms 'jug rjes chags rol mo'i 'od zer sprin/ /dpag yas nam mkha' khyab par 'phros pa yis/ /'og min bde chen pad+ma 'od la sogs/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas/ /ye shes spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur/ hrīḥ rje btsun o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos ye shes sgyu ma'i sku/ /rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas/ /rtse gcig mos pas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ /gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*/ /'gag med snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang gis/ /bdag sogs 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral ba dang*/ /byin rlabs dngos grub rtsol phyir skur bzhengs shig /hrīḥ gnyis su 'dzin pa'i snang ba rnam dag pa/ /ro gcig gnyug ma'i ngang du phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang shar bde stong rol mor 'char ba'i dpyid/ /'od gsal thig le chen po'i mchod par 'bul/ /blos byas 'khrul pa'i sdig ltung ji snyed kun/ /'gyur med yongs grub ka dag klong du bshags/ /mkha' ltar rab zhi skye ba med pa'i don/ /dran 'dzin gnyen po bral la rjes yi rang*/ /sgra tshig mtshan ma'i chos las rnam grol ba'i/ /don dam rtogs pa'i chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /yongs grub rtag pa dam pa'i bdag nyid che/ /rnam kun mchog ldan chen por bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dge tshogs 'khor gsum las 'das pa/ /srid zhi mi gnas dbu ma'i dbyings su bsngo/ hrīḥ 'chi med rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /nye rgyu'i bde ster man+dā ra bar bcas/ /rab 'byams rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /rtag tu snying nas gus pas gsol 'debs na/ /gnas skabs dngos nyams rmi lam snang cha ru/ /mgon po dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal myur mthong zhing*/ /mthar thug rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i them skas la/

/brten nas sku bzhi'i pha mthar phyin gyur cig /khyad par tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /rlung sems zung 'jug sgyu ma'i skur ldang ste/ /bde chen pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du/ /'chi med gdod ma'i go 'phang mngon gyur shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes pas gsol 'debs bsnyen par 'bad/ /skabs su mos gus drag po'i ngang*/ /byin rlabs tshad med rdo rje'i gsung*/ /gsol 'debs rgyud bskul ci rigs bya/ /res 'ga' snang grags rigs gsum kun/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su blta/ /lam khyer hūm̐ lnga'i snang glu len/ /thun mthar dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ /rtse gcig gus pas bsnyen cing gsol btab mthus/ /skyabs kun 'dus zhal 'chi med pad+ma 'byung*/ /yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i mkha' gsang nas/ /bde chen byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /zla ba zhun ma'i mdog can dpag med babs/ /spyi bo nas zhugs rtsa khams kun khyab pas/ /dbang bzhi thob cing sgrib bzhi'i 'ching ba sbyangs/ /sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'grub pa'i skal ba bzhag /mthar thug lha tshogs 'od zhu rang nyid dang*/ /dbyer med ma bcos 'od gsal blo 'das ngang*/ /rig stong spros bral gdod ma'i thod phreng rtsal/ /lhun grub rig 'dzin rang zhal mthong bar gyur/ /zhes brjod rig stong rjen par bzhag /de ltar mos gus rtse gcig gis/ /zab mo'i lam 'di nyams blangs na/ /don gnyis 'grub par the tshom med/ /mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog dang*/ /rjes thob nges gsang gdams pa 'di/ /rnal 'byor gzhon nu'i rtog chos te/ /skal bzang rnams kyi dpal du shog /bde chen snying dbus dbu ma'i klong*/ /'od gsal stong pa'i he ru kas/ /'du 'bral med par rjes bzung nas/ /rnam kun mchog ldan nyid gyur cig/ //
